mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id, dp.ticker, dp.name FROM account a JOIN domestic_stock_balance b ON b.account_id = a.account_id JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE b.qty > 0 AND b.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') AND dp.type = 'STOCK' AND dp.ticker REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' AND dp.name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dp.name) != '' ORDER BY a.customer_id, dp.ticker, dp.name

SELECT dp.ticker, dp.name, dp.sector_name, st.name AS theme FROM domestic_product dp LEFT JOIN domestic_product_theme dpt ON dpt.domestic_product_id = dp.domestic_product_id LEFT JOIN stock_theme st ON st.stock_theme_id = dpt.stock_theme_id WHERE dp.type = 'STOCK' ORDER BY dp.ticker, st.name

WITH eligible_products AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dp.domestic_product_id, st.name AS theme FROM domestic_product dp JOIN domestic_product_theme dpt ON dpt.domestic_product_id = dp.domestic_product_id JOIN stock_theme st ON st.stock_theme_id = dpt.stock_theme_id WHERE dp.type = 'STOCK' AND dp.ticker REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' AND st.name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.name) != '' ), current_themes AS ( SELECT ep.theme, SUM(b.qty) AS current_qty FROM account a JOIN domestic_stock_balance b ON b.account_id = a.account_id JOIN eligible_products ep ON ep.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND b.qty > 0 AND b.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') GROUP BY ep.theme ), theme_orders AS ( SELECT ep.theme, o.domestic_order_id, CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN o.qty ELSE -o.qty END AS delta FROM account a JOIN domestic_order o ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN eligible_products ep ON ep.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' ), balances AS ( SELECT theme, domestic_order_id, delta, SUM(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY theme ORDER BY domestic_order_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_qty, SUM(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY theme) AS net_qty FROM theme_orders ) SELECT ct.theme, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ct.current_qty - b.net_qty >= 0 AND ct.current_qty - b.net_qty + b.running_qty > 0 AND ct.current_qty - b.net_qty + b.running_qty - b.delta = 0 THEN b.domestic_order_id ELSE 0 END), 0) AS priority FROM current_themes ct LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.theme = ct.theme GROUP BY ct.theme ORDER BY ct.theme
